body.en: Read any PDF with dark pages, from the PDF toolbar or the command palette.
body.zh: 在 PDF 工具栏或命令面板中开启，即可以深色页面阅读任意 PDF。

body.en: Open a PDF or a paper to the side to read it next to another, each with its own page and zoom.
body.zh: 把 PDF 或论文在侧边打开，与另一个 PDF 并排阅读，各自保留页码和缩放。

title.en: Newer Claude models in the AI assistant
title.zh: AI 助手支持更新的 Claude 模型

body.en: Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are in the model picker, and a Claude Code that is too old for a model now says which version that model needs.
body.zh: 模型选择器中新增 Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5；如果 Claude Code 版本过低，会提示该模型需要的版本。

fixes.en: A stray " inside a braced BibTeX field, as Zotero writes it, no longer hides every later entry or makes Add papers fail.
fixes.zh: BibTeX 花括号字段中多出的 "（Zotero 会这样写）不会再导致后面的条目全部消失，也不会让添加论文失败。

fixes.en: In the AI assistant, the conversation scrolls with the pointer over a wide table.
fixes.zh: 在 AI 助手中，指针停在宽表格上时也能滚动对话。

fixes.en: A saved Fable choice uses Fable 5.1 when Claude Code is older than 2.1.321.
fixes.zh: Claude Code 版本低于 2.1.321 时，已保存的 Fable 选择会使用 Fable 5.1。
